scope: Every problem and subpart read and independently retraced; source conventions checked against actual local PDF pages. This ledger does not treat a passing compilation or an existing test as proof of all mathematics.
textbook: John David Jackson - Classical Electrodynamics (1998, Wiley) - libgen.li.pdf
review_evidence: Actual section files, rendered/OCR textbook theory pages, new derivations and independent checks in the chapter script; existing checks also rerun with warnings as errors.
